question: Where should Viṣvaksena be worshipped in relation to the main deity?
premises: Viṣvaksena is the object of worship.
His position is inside on the left of the deity.
inference: Viṣvaksena should be worshipped inside on the left side of the deity.
plain_english: One should worship Viṣvaksena inside, on the left side of the deity.
